authority.scope: Read-only inspection of GTK2 stepper asset and RC composition. No runtime candidate or product change.

observations.product_rc: GTK2 binds a complete 15x15 image to each scrollbar STEPPER and a separate 11x11 image to ARROW for each state.
observations.theme_lab_rc: The saved Theme Lab snapshot binds a complete 15x15 cell image through STEPPER overlay_file and has no separate ARROW rules.

conclusion: The repository's complete normal stepper cells exactly match the SR10.4 reference. Centered alpha composition of the paired current 11x11 arrow overlays also remains pixel-identical. The existence of both RC rules alone does not prove double painting or explain the live widget mismatch. Runtime placement, clipping, style/state selection, or loaded revision remain candidates for investigation.

technical_coverage_estimate.basis: Adds source and pixel-composition evidence but does not close the GTK2 renderer cause, pressed-state VM pairs, remaining GTK2 audit, or user visual review.

next: After P10 authorization is saved, run one isolated GTK2 runtime comparison of the current RC and a private candidate that changes only scrollbar ARROW painting; record left/right 15x15 and vertical cells at 1:1 before considering product changes.
